qualifier: via phospholipase A2 and cyclooxygenase
name: Cyclooxygenase-derived prostanoid synthesis and prostanoid receptors
rationale: All members cover arachidonate release by PLA2, COX conversion to prostaglandins/thromboxanes and their receptors, distinguishing the theme from leukotriene/lipoxin themes and from regulation-of-prostaglandin-secretion themes.

qualifier: germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
name: B cell development, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell identity signatures, B cell proliferation/differentiation, germinal centre, Tfh/ICOS/CD27 help and plasma/memory cell programmes, unlike confusables centred on BCR signal transduction, isotype switching or T cell/thymic development.

qualifier: JNK and p38 with AP-1 induction
name: JNK and p38 stress kinase signalling with AP-1 induction
rationale: Members regulate JNK/p38 stress-activated cascades via TAK1 and the AP-1/immediate-early transcriptional output (TNF-NFkB, NR4A, growth arrest), distinguishing it from NOD1/2 sensing, ERK feedback and UV-response themes.

qualifier: assembly, remodelling and clearance of all lipoprotein classes
name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodelling and clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodelling and clearance, whereas confusables emphasise lipase complexes, triglyceride catabolism or regulation of clearance and lack the assembly steps.

qualifier: through SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptors
name: ERBB receptor signalling through SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptors
rationale: Members are adaptor-recruitment events (SHC1, GRB2, PI3K) downstream of EGFR, ERBB2, ERBB3 and ERBB4, unlike confusables about MET, EGFR transactivation, ERBB2 motility/PLCG1 or ERBB4 nuclear signalling.

qualifier: T cell tolerance, NK and dendritic cell activation
name: Immunoregulatory receptors in T cell tolerance and NK/dendritic cell activation
rationale: Members concern lymphoid/non-lymphoid immunoregulatory and KIR receptors controlling T cell costimulation, anergy and tolerance, NK activation and DC differentiation, unlike confusables focused on Treg differentiation or NK cytotoxicity.

qualifier: atrophy and activity-dependent adaptation
name: Skeletal muscle growth, atrophy and activity-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover skeletal muscle development, fibre differentiation, growth, atrophy and responses to activity or inactivity, distinguishing it from cardiac adaptation, satellite-cell regeneration and contraction/sarcomere themes.

qualifier: multiciliogenesis in brain ventricles and sperm motility
name: Multiciliogenesis and ciliary motility in brain ventricles and sperm
rationale: Members cover multiciliated-cell centriole/basal body formation, ventricular development and CSF circulation, and sperm/cilium motility, whereas confusables centre on axonemal dynein assembly and mucociliary clearance.

qualifier: RNA polymerase III promoters and snRNA genes
name: RNA polymerase III and snRNA gene transcription initiation
rationale: Members cover Pol III initiation at type 1-3 promoters (tRNA, snRNA) and Pol II/III snRNA gene transcription, unlike confusables dominated by Pol III elongation/termination and rRNA processing.

qualifier: adhesion-receptor (GPVI, GPIb-IX-V) signalling
name: Platelet adhesion-receptor activation, aggregation and degranulation
rationale: Members cover platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation and coagulation with collagen/GPVI and GPIb-IX-V adhesion signalling, unlike confusables centred on GPCR agonist (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane) signalling or VWF variants.

qualifier: defensins in intestinal epithelium and microbiota
name: Defensin antimicrobial peptides shaping intestinal epithelium and microbiota
rationale: Members cover alpha/beta-defensin and antibacterial peptide production together with intestinal epithelial and stem cell maintenance and microbiota modulation, unlike confusables on broader humoral/mucosal antimicrobial responses or intestinal epithelial identity.

qualifier: decapping-initiated 5' to 3' exonucleolytic
name: Decapping-initiated 5' to 3' mRNA decay
rationale: All three members describe cap removal followed by 5'-3' exonucleolytic mRNA degradation, distinct from deadenylation, ARE-mediated decay and mRNA stabilisation confusables.

qualifier: non-oxidative pentose phosphate and glucuronate-xylulose routes
name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate and glucuronate-xylulose metabolism
rationale: Members concern xylulose-5-phosphate and pentose interconversion via the non-oxidative PPP (TALDO1, RPIA deficiencies) and the glucuronate pathway (pentosuria), unlike fructose, glycerol and galactose confusables.

qualifier: SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing
name: Hedgehog signal transduction via SMO and proteasomal GLI processing
rationale: Most members are Hedgehog pathway steps (SMO activation, GLI processing/degradation, GLI transcription) alongside proteasomal DVL and SLIT/ROBO regulation, unlike confusables on Wnt/Notch, planar polarity or Hh ligand lipidation.

qualifier: OTU-family enzymes, K11 and K48 chains
name: OTU deubiquitinase cleavage of K11 and K48 ubiquitin chains
rationale: Members are ovarian tumour domain proteases and K11/K48-linked deubiquitination, distinguishing them from USP/UCH/Josephin DUBs, ubiquitination machinery and NF-kB regulation confusables.

qualifier: Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Listeria
name: Mycobacterial and Listeria subversion of host cell defences
rationale: Members describe intracellular bacteria (Mtb, Listeria InlB) entering host cells and suppressing apoptosis, autophagy, NO, membrane repair and phagolysosome fusion, unlike confusables on phagosome acidification, iron assimilation or toxins.

qualifier: TBK1-IRF3 type I interferon induction
name: dsRNA sensing driving TBK1-IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 and TLR3 dsRNA sensing and TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/IRF7 for type I IFN induction, distinguishing it from RLR-NF-kB, cGAS/STING and downstream interferon-stimulated gene themes.

qualifier: TGF-beta/activin receptors, regulation and cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta and activin SMAD2/3 signalling, regulation and cancer mutants
rationale: Members cover TGFBR/activin/AMH receptor-SMAD2/3:SMAD4 signalling, its downregulation, TGFBR3, RUNX3 tumour-suppressor targets and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, unlike BMP, MET and Hippo-YAP confusables.

qualifier: synthesis, transport and receptor signalling
name: Thyroid hormone synthesis, transport and receptor signalling
rationale: All members concern thyroid hormone generation, transport, activity and receptor responses, distinguishing it from growth hormone/prolactin/leptin and selenium or peroxide confusables.

qualifier: semaphorin-plexin repulsion and growth-cone collapse
name: Semaphorin-plexin repulsive axon guidance and growth-cone collapse
rationale: Members are Sema3A/Sema4D-plexin signalling (CRMPs, PAK, RND1, integrin inhibition) in axon guidance and innervation, unlike netrin- and ephrin-based guidance confusables.

qualifier: classical pathway, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
name: Classical complement activation, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
rationale: Members cover antibody-mediated (and GZMK) complement activation through C3/C5 to opsonization, while confusables add the alternative pathway and negative regulation of the cascade.

qualifier: SREBP transcriptional control
name: SREBP transcriptional control of cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members are SREBP signalling and target-motif modules, positive/negative regulation of cholesterol synthesis and ER sterol transport, unlike confusables on cholesterol efflux, ATF6 UPR or fatty acid homeostasis.

qualifier: phenylalanine/tyrosine with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor synthesis
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine and tyrosine degradation (including phenylketonuria) and BH4 synthesis/recycling required for phenylalanine hydroxylase, unlike sulfur, vitamin B6 and generic amino acid confusables.

qualifier: integrin and S1P-guided, secondary lymphoid tissue
name: Integrin and S1P-guided lymphocyte homing to secondary lymphoid tissue
rationale: Members cover integrin adhesion, S1P receptor signalling and lymphocyte migration into lymph nodes, MALT/GALT and marginal zone, unlike confusables driven by chemokine chemotaxis or T cell synapse/endothelial extravasation.

qualifier: CD1 lipid antigens to NKT cells
name: CD1 lipid antigen presentation and NKT cell activation
rationale: Members cover CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation and NKT cell differentiation, activation and proliferation (with a DC TLR7/8 cluster), unlike MHC class II peptide presentation and monocyte or IL-12 confusables.
